concerns.text: FR-004 and US-2 acceptance scenario 2 mandate Type I error estimation 'by shuffling group labels multiple times with a fixed random seed' on the filtered datasets. T005/T007 instead estimate it exclusively on simulated null data (real data used only for shape estimation). The plan's methodological correction is defensible, but the spec was never amended, so the tasks silently relax a stated FR. Amend FR-004/US-2 to codify the simulated-null method (and note the permutation-based label assignment) rather than leaving the contradiction.

FR-001 requires datasets 'from UCI Machine Learning Repository and OpenML'; Constitution VI names both repositories. T002 fetches exclusively via sklearn fetch_openml, narrowing the requirement with no documented justification in plan.md or tasks.md. Either add UCI sourcing or document the narrowing as an approved deviation in the spec.

T006/T008 explicitly include an 'untransformed baseline' condition (4 transforms incl. baseline), but the aggregated_result.schema.yaml transformation enum permits only box_cox/yeo_johnson/rank_based. The baseline rows T008 promises would violate the contract it claims to conform to. Extend the contract enum (e.g. 'untransformed') or drop the baseline.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T006 vs spec.md:US-4 Independent Test / SC-003
concerns.text: US-4's independent test requires power estimates to 'match expected values within 95% CI half-width ±0.02' against known ground truth, and US-4 scenario 3 says CIs are 'validated against the ±0.02 half-width target'. T006's verification only checks power ∈ [0,1] and file existence; no task compares estimated power to analytically expected power for known Cohen's d, and the ±0.02 CI validation appears only for Type I error aggregation (T008/SC-004). This acceptance criterion is dropped.

T003 excludes datasets with 'no continuous variable', but the dataset schema's filter_reason enum offers only normal/small_n/missing_too_high/no_group — no value represents that exclusion, so schema-conformant logging as promised cannot be done. Add a 'no_continuous_var' value or map it explicitly.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001 vs plan.md:Technical Context dependency list
concerns.text: T001 requires portalocker for file locking, but the plan's pinned dependency list does not include it; the isolated virtualenv built from requirements.txt would lack it. Ensure portalocker is added to the pinned dependencies (or use an stdlib locking approach).

concerns.location: tasks.md:T005, T007 vs plan.md:Project Structure / data-model.md:Storage Strategy
concerns.text: T005 writes to data/results/type1_error_pilot.json and T007 to results/type1_error/[stratum].json, while plan.md and data-model.md specify results/type1_error_results.csv; 'data/results/' appears nowhere in the plan's structure. Align result paths across artifacts.

The plan's complexity table asserts 'Friedman test is inappropriate for correlated proportions; GLMM is required', yet T009 (per FR-008) implements Friedman as the primary test with GLMM as a robustness check, inverting the plan's stated rationale without reconciliation.
